title: Agent provenance records
description: Execution identity and per-event actor records (kind, id, provider, model, runtime, execution id) for agent work.
notes: Covers engineering work in repositories that use Praxis; not runtime product agents.

title: Delegation chain records
description: Per delegated sub-agent run: delegator, delegate, authority subset, expiry and attribution.

title: Authority matrix version and agent permission review
description: Versioned authority matrix with approver, plus periodic agent permission review results and removed permissions.

title: Self-grant and out-of-authority denial tests and reports
description: Negative test results (AUTH-T01) and reports of rate-limited out-of-authority requests sent to agent owners.

title: Reserved authority enforcement tests
description: Negative and property tests showing agent actor types are rejected for approve, release, payee-change, trade and clear commands.

title: Approval binding and segregation records
description: Per approval: proposal hash, evidence hash, approver, preparer, invalidation events and segregation checks.

title: Quarterly delegation report and sampling results
description: Board-acknowledged report of auto-approved, held and declined items plus independent sample review outcomes.

title: Emergency stop test records
description: Dated emergency stop exercises with suspended action counts, in-flight outcomes, deterministic path continuity and resumption approvals.

title: Decision packages
description: Replayable decision packages with accountable actor, evidence snapshot, AI contribution versions and policy version.

title: Evidence store write-path report and integrity verification
description: Generated report of identities with write access to evidence stores, plus hash-chain verification results and denied agent write attempts.

title: AI summary labeling and environment tags
description: Records showing evidence items tagged by environment and provenance, AI summaries labeled with source links, and withdrawal records.

title: Answer library build results
description: Build tool output showing schema validation and honesty checks over all answer units.

title: Questionnaire release sign-off
description: Per released response: questionnaire id, answer unit ids and versions, reviewer, signatory and date.

title: Branch protection and change approval records
description: Repository protection configuration export and per-merge approval records showing approver distinct from prompter and agent author.

title: Agent production access report
description: Report of agent identities with any production or cloud credentials, scoped diagnostic grants and per-case write approvals.
